replies.text:
Step 2 check:

- Automated abuse of anything reachable: design has "Agents pass messages through a shared queue without authentication" — flooding of that queue is already covered by listed threat 6; there is no sign-in form, email/SMS send, sign-up or scrapeable page in the design text.
- Staff/admin/moderator screens showing other people's content: design names no console, dashboard or review screen — the only components are "A planner agent delegates to a flights agent and a payments agent." Not applicable.
- Money movement or privileged action with no record of who did it: design has "The payments agent can charge the user's saved card" — already covered by listed threat 7 (charges cannot be attributed) and threat 3.
- Personal/financial documents or pages cacheable by browsers/proxies/CDNs: design describes no page, document or HTTP response at all. Not applicable.
- Attacker-controlled text reaching logs, CSV/spreadsheet exports, emails, headers or another interpreting system: design mentions only queue messages between agents; no export, log, email or header sink is stated. The supplier-text path is already covered by listed threat 2. Not applicable.

Single-reviewer items: "No human confirmation before money leaves the user's card" is already inside listed threat 3 ("no amount cap, allow-listed merchant, or explicit human confirmation"); delegation loop and replay/duplicate charges rest on retry, nonce and idempotency behaviour the design never states; shared-identity/scope items restate listed threats 2 and 3 for the same money harm. None qualify as gaps.
